{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Stratify by customer_segment and compute conversion rate within each stratum
stratified_conversion = sales_df.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['converted'].mean().unstack(level='channel')

# Check the actual column names
print(stratified_conversion.columns)

# Compute the difference in conversion rates within each segment
diffs = stratified_conversion['email'] - stratified_conversion['paid_search']

# Compute the overall difference, weighted by segment size within each channel
segment_sizes = sales_df.groupby('channel')['customer_segment'].value_counts().unstack(fill_value=0)

# Weighted average difference
weighted_diff = (diffs * segment_sizes['email']).sum() / segment_sizes['email'].sum()

stratified_conversion, diffs, weighted_diff"}
